name: Claude Code
description: Tells Claude Code that Polter is here: registers the MCP server under the user scope and mirrors Polter's skills into ~/.claude/skills/polter-*. Without it an agent has the socket and the token in its environment and no way to use either.

scope.title: Which Claude Code scope to register in
scope.description: user puts the server in ~/.claude.json for every directory; local puts it in this machine's project entry only. user is the point of doing this at all -- a project scope is exactly the case that already worked.

skills.title: Install skills as well
skills.description: yes mirrors Polter's skills into ~/.claude/skills/polter-*. Claude Code matches its own skills against what the user asked for; Polter's skill_read has to be thought of first, which is why a supervisor told to mind some terminals reaches for a subagent instead. no registers the MCP server and nothing else.
